notes: Reference date 2018-02-26. Governing documents: Policy 14 (Class FS pregnancy, adoption and parental leave policy covering faculty; last updated 2006, so the same text was in force on the reference date), Policies 3, 76, 23 and the UW/FAUW Memorandum of Agreement. missing = false: Policy 14 is a governing parental-leave policy covering tenure-stream faculty (the no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply).
Policy 77 (2018_04) holds no leave provision (tenure criteria and procedures only). Policy 23 lists plan eligibility only (UW Sick Leave Plan, LTD) without amounts.

Policy 14 Appendix A summarises the statutes as they stood before 2017: ESA parental leave 35/37 weeks and a two-week EI waiting period. The saved statutes in force on the reference date govern: ESA parental 61 weeks after pregnancy leave / 63 otherwise (s. 49(1), in force 2017-12-03), EI waiting period one week (s. 13). The UW pay schedule is coded as written (6 weeks 100% birth leave, then 17 weeks top-up to 95%), per R21.

HR summary table (2018_01_note): undated, Wayback capture 2019-08-21, after the reference academic year; it restates Policy 14 and adds the extended-EI option (top-up of the same amount with the 33% benefit) and '100% of salary for 10 days'. Used only for notes; no coded value depends on it alone. Its 'Support for nursing mothers' (fridge loan) is not time off, pay, relief or protection: not a component.

Birth parent chain: ESA pregnancy leave 17 (c1) → ESA parental leave 61 (c2); pay: UW birth leave 6 weeks at 100% (c3, within c1 from week 0) → UW top-up to 95% 17 weeks (c4, consecutive_after c3, weeks 6-23); EI maternity 15 (c6, concurrent_with c1, offset 1) → EI parental 35 (c7, consecutive_after c6); then on return the proportional teaching reduction (c11, consecutive_after c2, no weeks).

Non-birth parent chain: ESA parental leave 63 (c2); pay: either UW top-up to 95% for 17 weeks within c2 from its start (c4) or, in lieu, 10 paid work days around the birth (c5); EI parental 35 (c7, concurrent_with c2, offset 1); then c11 on return.

Adoptive parents: ESA parental leave, the 17-week top-up (Appendix B: 2 weeks at 95% salary in the EI waiting period + 15 weeks integrated with EI) and EI parental benefits; recorded within c2, c4 and c7 (adoptive listed), counted in neither role (R5).

Not components (no time off, pay, relief, job or tenure-clock protection): sabbatical credit earned during the leave and rescheduling of a sabbatical interrupted by the leave (Policy 14 §3); salaries 'normally will not be affected' and full scale and selective increases during the leave (Policy 14 §4; MOA 13.4.2); performance ratings exclude pregnancy, adoption, parental and sick leave and a member on leave receives the average of three previous years (MOA 13.5.4); vacation accrues during the leave (Policy 14 §4); benefits continue, pension optional once supplementary pay ends (Policy 14 §5; Policy 3 §5); MOA 7.1 non-discrimination on grounds including pregnancy and family status (general equal treatment, no job-holding for absence). Sabbatical (Policy 3 §3) and political leave (Policy 3 App. A) cannot be used for a birth.

Policy 14 footnote: parents 'may use vacation credits, unpaid leave, lieu time and personal leave in order to be present at the birth'. Vacation is c17, unpaid leave c12; 'lieu time' and 'personal leave' are not defined in any saved document (no component).

Documents cited but not saved: Policy 59 (Reduced Workload); Policy 39 (staff leaves); Policy 1 and its Appendix A; Policies 4 and 24 (tuition); Policy 28 (moving); Policy 31 (travel); Policy 38 (paid holidays); Policy 49; Policy 67 (EAP); Policy 69 (conflict of interest); Policy 73 (intellectual property); the Pension and Benefits Booklets; the official Pension Plan text and insurance contracts (Policy 23 §3); Memorandum of Settlement (MOA Art. 10); Faculty Performance Evaluation Guidelines and Departmental Addenda; form 1311-12; the 'partial leave of absence' that Policy 76 refers to Policy 3 for (not described in the saved Policy 3).

Calendar: Policy 3 and Policy 76 describe three terms a year ('one term (approximately four months)'), not a semester or quarter and not a length in weeks; no calendar recorded and no component is coded in terms.
Statutory floor (U7): Ontario ESA pregnancy 17 + parental 61 (birth), parental 63 (other parent); coded as c1 and c2, so the floor is already held by those components.
